crossRefs.note: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.

translations.web: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter; for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.
translations.bsb: and from the abundance of milk they give, he will eat curds; for all who remain in the land will eat curds and honey.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.
translations.asv: and it shall come to pass, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the midst of the land.
